name: ai-error-function-role-refused
description: The accepted round trip of ai-function-response-round, with the function response under role function instead of user, is refused 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT. @firebase/ai 2.12.0 ChatSession sends role function for function responses, so a real SDK chat with tools fails here. The message names the refused role and lists a longer role vocabulary than ai-error-bad-role.

behavior.messageText: Role 'function' is not supported. Please use a valid role: SYSTEM, SYSTEM_1, USER, ASSISTANT, DEVELOPER, CONTEXT, USER_CONTEXT, MODEL, USER.

error.message: Role 'function' is not supported. Please use a valid role: SYSTEM, SYSTEM_1, USER, ASSISTANT, DEVELOPER, CONTEXT, USER_CONTEXT, MODEL, USER.
